content.aboutBody: Join us for four days of meetings designed to prepare our hearts and homes for what lies ahead. Together we'll consider what it means to build a home that honors God now, in view of the eternal home He is preparing for us.
content.quote: "The well-being of society, the success of the church, and the prosperity of the nation truly depend upon home influences."
content.quoteAttribution: ELLEN G. WHITE, THE ADVENTIST HOME, p. 15.1
